def min_moves_to_sort(n, p):
    from bisect import bisect_left

    def length_of_lis(sequence):
        lis = []

            if pos == len(lis):
                lis.append(value)

    lis_length = length_of_lis(p)

    # The minimum number of moves is the total number of cars minus the length of the LIS
    return n - lis_length

            pos = bisect_left(lds, -num)
            if pos == len(lds):
                lds.append(-num)
            else:

        return len(lds)

    lds_length = longest_decreasing_subsequence(p[::-1])

    # The minimum number of moves is the total number of cars minus the length of the LDS
    return n - lds_length
